Calculate a pseudobulk replication-timing signal

Source: R/pseudobulk.R
calculate_pseudobulk_rt.Rd

Aggregate QC-passed S-phase cells (pass_qc & !is_G1) and G1 cells (is_G1), correct the S-phase counts for GC content and mappability using the G1 pseudobulk, normalise by the genome-wide mean, z-score, set bins with |z| > extreme_cutoff to NA, smooth with stats::smooth.spline() within mappable contigs, then z-score and filter the smoothed signal again.

Usage

calculate_pseudobulk_rt(
  genobins_matrix,
  genome_granges,
  meta_data,
  extreme_cutoff = 5,
  min.gapwidth = 40001L,
  min_bins_per_contig = 5,
  min_non_na_points = 2,
  smooth_spar = NULL
)

Arguments

genobins_matrix

dgCMatrix of raw counts, genome bins x cells, with row names equal to names(genome_granges) and column names equal to rownames(meta_data).

genome_granges

Named GRanges with metadata columns is_mappable, gc_frequency and mappability (e.g. from compute_bin_mappability()).

meta_data

A data.frame with logical columns is_G1 and pass_qc.

extreme_cutoff

Absolute z-score above which bins are set to NA.

min.gapwidth

Passed to GenomicRanges::reduce() to build contigs.

min_bins_per_contig

Minimum number of bins of a smoothed contig.

min_non_na_points

Minimum number of non-NA points for the spline.

smooth_spar

NULL (automatic) or spar of stats::smooth.spline().

Value

A sorted GRanges of the bins with a non-NA smoothed signal, with the single metadata column score.

Details

GC/mappability correction (on mappable bins): with g1m = g1_counts / mappability, mGC = median of g1m within bins of the same round(gc_frequency, 2) and m = median of all g1m, the corrected S signal is (m / mGC) * s_counts / mappability (NA where mGC == 0). Contigs are mappable bins merged with GenomicRanges::reduce(min.gapwidth = min.gapwidth); contigs with fewer than min_bins_per_contig bins or fewer than min_non_na_points distinct positions are not smoothed.
